sources: Microsoft Learn: 'SystemParametersInfoW function', SPI_SETKEYBOARDDELAY (0 = shortest delay, about 250 ms) and SPI_SETKEYBOARDSPEED (31 = fastest, about 30 repeats per second). Same values as the sliders in Control Panel > Keyboard. The app restores both previous values when resetting.
Games that read the keys directly are not affected; the setting applies to held keys in Windows, chats and menus.
